answers.question: platform 3: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Open. OSM ties no lift, escalator or stairs to platform 3, and no owner source says how it is reached; JLT's map labels 'Spår 3' but its text shows no lifts or stairs.
answers._source: OpenStreetMap (osmfacts/740000140.json, ODbL), read 2026-10-30; JLT terminal map 'Nässjö station', https://www.jlt.se/globalassets/dokument-2024/terminalkartor/jlt_terminalkartor_nassjo.pdf (valid from August 2024; linked from Jernhusen's 'Karta över stationsområdet'), read 2026-10-30; facts only

answers.question: platform 4: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Probably wrong in the app: OSM tags lift n9976358824 and escalators w185047086/w185047095 as reaching platforms 2a, 2b and 4 (one island platform, it seems), up to footbridge w185047096. JLT confirms the station has a lift and an escalator but not where. Check that the draft joins these to platform 4.

answers.question: platform 1a: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Likely correct but only from OSM: 1a/1b is the platform on the station-building side; OSM ties no lift, escalator or stairs to it, and no owner source says otherwise.

answers.question: platform 1b: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: As for 1a: likely correct, OSM only.

answers.question: cafe Espresso House: no opening hours
answers.answer: OSM now has Mo-Fr 06:30-19:00; Sa,Su 09:30-18:00 (node n13030193198). Not confirmed by Espresso House: its café list could only be read up to a different café, and Jernhusen gives no hours.

answers.question: shop Pressbyrån: no opening hours
answers.answer: OSM now has Mo-Fr 05:30-21:00; Sa 08:00-21:00; Su 09:00-21:00 (node n13030233594). Not confirmed by Pressbyrån (store finder loads by script) or Jernhusen (no hours).
